row.notes: Converts the career minute offset to a time (day table at calendar+0x08, 16 bytes per day, plus minute-of-day*60 from Career_Calc_CalendarDayIndex) and reads tm_wday via localtime. It steps back and forward in 1440-minute days, up to 7 each way, until it finds the week start (tm_wday==1 or minute 0) and the week end (tm_wday==0 or the career length from Career_Get_CareerLengthDays_Thunk). Returns start in the low 32 bits and end in the high 32 bits, or 0xffffffff in both if not found.
